name: Longwalker Malah

angles.text: As a tauren, you know the Longwalkers answer directly to High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof. Their safety matters to your people and to Mulgore's defense.
As a member of the Horde, you help Bloodhoof Village find missing border scouts and guard Mulgore against threats encroaching on Horde lands.
As a hunter, you respect the tracking skill and endurance it takes to patrol Mulgore's far edges on foot.

faq.answer: Longwalker Malah Longwind is a tauren scout serving the High Chieftain. She was sent to survey Mulgore's eastern border, wearing her order's traditional headband and carrying a feathered staff.
The Longwalkers are the tauren people's elite scouts and messengers. They answer directly to the High Chieftain, though young Baine Bloodhoof sometimes asks for their help with border intelligence.
Malah was sent to survey Mulgore's eastern border and was expected back within three days. Her absence has raised concern in Bloodhoof Village that she may have met trouble on the frontier.
faq.q: Why is Longwalker Malah being searched for?

faq.answer: Longwalker Malah was sent toward Mulgore's eastern frontier, past Bloodhoof Village toward the boundary ridge. Search the borderlands east of the village.
Malah wears a ceremonial headband and carries a feathered staff, the traditional marks of the Longwalkers.
faq.q: How do you recognize Longwalker Malah?

faq.answer: The Longwalkers answer to High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof, but his son Baine Bloodhoof sometimes asks for their tracking skills. He oversees local matters in Bloodhoof Village and uses their help to watch border activity and protect the valley.
faq.q: Why is Baine Bloodhoof involved with the Longwalkers?

sections.body: Across the plains, the Longwalkers serve as the shu'halo's eyes and ears. Pledged to High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof, these elite scouts travel vast territories to gather intelligence and carry vital messages. Their loyalty belongs to the High Chieftain alone. Young Baine Bloodhoof sometimes asks for their help protecting Bloodhoof Village and its surrounding pastures.
sections.title: The High Chieftain's Eyes

sections.body: Longwalker Malah Longwind was sent to watch Mulgore's eastern border on a three-day reconnaissance. She has not returned to Bloodhoof Village on schedule, and the village leadership is concerned. Longwalkers carry vital intelligence, while dangers line Mulgore's frontier cliffs. Scouts and willing travelers are called to follow Malah's trail and make sure she is safe. Her ceremonial headband and feathered staff mark her as one of the Longwalkers.
sections.title: Vanished on the Borderlands

summary: In Mulgore, Bloodhoof Village awaits Longwalker Malah’s return from the eastern borderlands. Sent to survey the frontier, she has been missing for three days, and the village needs to know she is safe.
